cleaned_entries.title: Docker Compose Security Baseline Reminders
cleaned_entries.content:
Docker Compose Security Baseline Reminders

Security reminders applied during Docker Compose generation: reference all secrets via environment variable substitution (${VAR}), limit published ports to those required externally, add persistent volumes only where genuinely needed.

Decision rules:
- Use ${VAR} syntax for all credentials — values come from .env file or Docker secrets
- Only publish ports (host:container) for services that need external access
- Add named volumes only for stateful services (databases, caches with persistence requirements)

Anti-patterns:
- Hardcoding passwords, tokens, or API keys directly in docker-compose.yml
- Publishing all internal service ports to 0.0.0.0 on the host
- Adding unnecessary volumes to stateless API containers
